'''November 2000 Paris tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Paris, France on 12 November 2000. [[Julien Riviere]] won it. It is known from Julien Riviere's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1455">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-13-paris-france-11-12-2000d1455/ paris-france-11-12-2000], DeckTech (Julien "Dark Padawan" Riviere, 13 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-13-paris-france-11-12-2000d1455/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 12 November 2000
* '''Site:''' Paris, France
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 16
* '''Winner:''' [[Julien Riviere]]
